package: W51-01 — preserved worktree histories listed and restored by original name
question: Can preserved worktree histories be browsed and brought back into a usable checkout?
answer: Yes. Archives are listed from their session metadata and restored into a fresh owned worktree at the original name, so archived session workspaces remain valid; ambiguous or occupied restores are refused.

sourcePosition.kind: local extension; archive layout has no recovered body
sourcePosition.evidence: recovered zPo (chunk-sfn1dbxq.js [1801370,1802540), UTF-8 bytes) reconciles stale state only from provable facts; listSessionDirectory is the existing session reader.

behavior.list: scan .agent/worktree-history for real <worktree>-<uuid> directories; report name, created, sessions, newest title
behavior.surface: /worktree-history lists up to 20; /worktree-history restore ARCHIVE accepts an exact name or unique prefix
behavior.restore: create a fresh owned worktree at the original name, write the W50 durable intent, rename the archive into <checkout>/.agent, clear the intent
behavior.refusal: occupied name/path/branch, existing checkout .agent, ambiguous selector, or an active worktree session
behavior.rollback: move the archive back before removing a created checkout; keep the checkout when the move back cannot be proven

changes.change: three C-4 rows record the completed picker
worktree relocation row records the picker

tests.added: preserved histories are listed and restored to their original name

residuals: Restore recreates the checkout at HEAD; the removed dirty or committed file state is only recoverable through checkpoints stored in the archive.
A crash after creating the checkout but before the intent leaves an empty owned worktree; it can be removed with the normal removal path.
Archives whose original branch still exists cannot be restored until that branch is removed.
